item.tib: tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi dbang chog yid bzhin 'byung ba
item.coloph: de ltar rig 'dzin gyi lag khrid du sdeb pa ni/ bslab gsum gyi dbang phyug bshes gnyen dam pa/ gya gyong drang srong g.yung drung shes rab kyi thugs kyis bzhed pa nan cher gsungs gis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ rje btsun sman ri ba'i phyag len ci lta ba/ drin chen rin po che sprul sku khri 'od rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rgyun bzhin du/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro bon skor la blo kha phyogs pa'i/ khyung po'i sngags 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub zhes bya bas/ sgrub gnas rdo rje steng dgon yang dben du sbyar ba dge'o//
